verdict.rationale: Airweave keeps a persistent, searchable copy of synced data in collections, so asking whether that store can be exported is a fair data-lifecycle question. The evidence documents only search, sync, MCP, CLI search, webhooks and self-hosting. None of it shows a documented export of stored collection data in a machine-readable format. Self-hosting and open source are adjacent portability factors, not an export capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can export memories in a machine-readable format so the memory store is portable and not a lock-in trap
